**Data (all read-only, point-in-time):** Kite 5-minute candles, 30 sessions (21 Sep–3 Nov 2026), 1,593 NSE stocks with 20-session
average volume ≥ 50,000 and price ≥ 20 (6 not found at Kite); the scan builder's adjusted NSE end-of-day history; Kite 5-minute
index candles (28 indices) and November stock-future candles with OI (218); from the NIDP warehouse: previous-day futures and
option OI (F&O bhavcopy), company results with announcement times, corporate announcements with times and sentiment, the feature
store's previous-day row, mutual-fund scheme changes with publication times, bulk / block deals, stock → industry → sector index.

**Caveats:** 30 sessions only (train 20, test 10), no costs or slippage — an indication of what to watch, not a tested strategy.
165 stock-days skipped where Kite and the warehouse price a stock on different scales (corporate actions adjusted differently,
e.g. INFY −2.2 %, CCAVENUE 10×). F&O stocks' Kite candles often stop at 15:10, so late-day moves can be missed for them. Quality
scores are point-in-time only from 13 Oct, deals from 9 Oct, fund holdings are monthly. The trade-side (TrueData) condition of
"10x volume first 5 min" is not replayed (TrueData keeps about a week of ticks; its login is refused since 3 Nov ~17:40).
Index memberships and the industry map are today's (mild look-ahead).

# Early signals of a ≥ 5 % rise from the open — study

Sessions: train 2026-09-21 … 2026-10-19 (20), test 2026-10-21 … 2026-11-03 (10). Stock-days: train 31,343 (2,111 rose ≥ 5 % above the open), test 15,847 (1,452).

A flag counts when it fires BEFORE the stock first reaches +5 % over its open ("hit rate" = share of those flags followed by +5 %; "lift" = hit rate ÷ the rate for every stock still below +5 % at the same step). Thresholds and the shortlist are chosen on the train sessions only; the test sessions check them. A signal "holds" when its test lift is ≥ 1.3× on ≥ 15 test flags. Medians are over the flags; upside and drawdown are from the flag price to the day's later high / the low before it. In-sample, ~30 sessions, no costs or slippage: an indication of what to look at, not a tested strategy.
